orders_amounts_check.name: orders_amounts_check
orders_amounts_check.value: "orders"."subtotal_iqd" >= 0 AND "orders"."discount_iqd" >= 0 AND "orders"."shipping_iqd" >= 0 AND "orders"."tax_iqd" >= 0 AND "orders"."total_iqd" >= 0 AND "orders"."paid_iqd" >= 0 AND "orders"."refunded_iqd" >= 0

wallet_topups_verified_check.name: wallet_topups_verified_check
wallet_topups_verified_check.value: "wallet_topups"."status" <> 'approved' OR ("wallet_topups"."verified_by" IS NOT NULL AND "wallet_topups"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)

recently_viewed_owner_check.name: recently_viewed_owner_check
recently_viewed_owner_check.value: "recently_viewed"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL OR "recently_viewed"."cart_token_hash" IS NOT NULL

wishlist_items_owner_check.name: wishlist_items_owner_check
wishlist_items_owner_check.value: "wishlist_items"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL OR "wishlist_items"."cart_token_hash" IS NOT NULL

trade_ins_amounts_check.name: trade_ins_amounts_check
trade_ins_amounts_check.value: ("trade_ins"."estimate_min_iqd" IS NULL OR "trade_ins"."estimate_min_iqd" >= 0) AND ("trade_ins"."estimate_max_iqd" IS NULL OR "trade_ins"."estimate_max_iqd" >= coalesce("trade_ins"."estimate_min_iqd", 0)) AND ("trade_ins"."final_offer_iqd" IS NULL OR "trade_ins"."final_offer_iqd" >= 0)
